# Factory Core Lite

> Free, MIT-licensed Godot 4 factory / automation starter kit / template in typed GDScript for Godot 4.7, with 65 passing headless tests (`bash tools/run_tests.sh`). The Pro edition (€16, commercial EULA, 245 tests) keeps the same API and adds the full feature set.

Copy `addons/factory_core/` into a Godot 4 project to use it. Content is data-driven (`examples/data/content.json`).

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/openclawaimac/godot-factory-core-lite/blob/main/README.md): features, quickstart, API, Lite vs Pro
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/openclawaimac/godot-factory-core-lite/blob/main/AGENTS.md): structure, how to extend, how to run tests, rules for coding agents
- [Website](https://openclawaimac.github.io/factory-core/): product page with Lite vs Pro table

## Code

- [addons/factory_core/sim/](https://github.com/openclawaimac/godot-factory-core-lite/tree/main/addons/factory_core/sim/): FactorySim (deterministic integer fixed-tick sim: step, link, report, to_save/load_save), FactorySimNode, FactoryStats
- [addons/factory_core/nodes/](https://github.com/openclawaimac/godot-factory-core-lite/tree/main/addons/factory_core/nodes/): belts (two-lane), source, sink, machine, splitter, merger
- [addons/factory_core/data/](https://github.com/openclawaimac/godot-factory-core-lite/tree/main/addons/factory_core/data/): FactoryItem, FactoryRecipe, FactoryBuildable, FactoryDB (Resources or JSON, validate())
- [addons/factory_core/power/, view/](https://github.com/openclawaimac/godot-factory-core-lite/tree/main/addons/factory_core/power/): power grid stub, FactoryView renderer
- [data/](https://github.com/openclawaimac/godot-factory-core-lite/tree/main/data/): sample .tres items/recipes/buildables
- [examples/](https://github.com/openclawaimac/godot-factory-core-lite/tree/main/examples/): demo.tscn (main scene), production_chain.gd, lite_view, data/content.json
- [tests/](https://github.com/openclawaimac/godot-factory-core-lite/tree/main/tests/): strict headless suite (run_tests.gd, harness.gd, expected.json)
- [tools/](https://github.com/openclawaimac/godot-factory-core-lite/tree/main/tools/): run_tests.sh, make_release.sh
